| almeida2026jev | 2026 | Introducing System One Models & Jev | decision-model, calibration, structured-output, typed-actions, non-autoregressive, real-time, game-agents, vendor-claims | read | Vendor launch post (TypeSafe), not a paper: Jev answers typed questions (yes/no, Score, Choice of up to 255 options) about a text state with calibrated probabilities, in parallel in one call, trained by "RLCD"; vendor evals: 67.8% (best 74.1%) at 0.4 s, $0.0004 per case; Doom demo on text state. |
| baker2022video | 2022 | Video PreTraining (VPT): Learning to Act by Watching Unlabeled Online Videos | imitation-learning, inverse-dynamics, behavioral-cloning, pretraining, reinforcement-learning, minecraft, video, transformer, action-space | read | An IDM trained on ~2k h of labelled play pseudo-labels ~70k h of web Minecraft video; a 0.5B causal transformer is behaviour-cloned on it from 128x128 pixels with native 20 Hz keyboard+mouse, and BC then RL fine-tuning (PPG + KL to the prior) crafts a diamond pickaxe in 2.5% of 10-min episodes. |
| chen2021decision | 2021 | Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling | reinforcement-learning, offline-rl, transformer, sequence-modeling, return-conditioning, atari, continuous-control, imitation-learning | read | Casts offline RL as conditional sequence modelling: a GPT over (return-to-go, state, action) tokens, trained with a supervised action loss and prompted with a target return; without TD learning it is comparable to CQL on 3 of 4 Atari games, best on most D4RL tasks, far above CQL and BC on Key-to-Door. |
| hafner2024mastering | 2024 | Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models | reinforcement-learning, world-model, model-based-rl, actor-critic, minecraft, atari, robustness, scaling | read | DreamerV3: an RSSM world model (CNN encoder, block GRU, discrete latents) plus actor-critic trained in 15-16-step imagination, one hyperparameter set for 150+ tasks in 8 domains, one A100 per run; first to get Minecraft diamonds from scratch (no human data); gains rest mostly on the reconstruction loss. |
| he2021masked | 2021 | Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners | self-supervised, representation-learning, vision-transformer, masked-image-modeling, pretraining, transfer-learning | read | MAE masks 75% of random ViT patches, encodes only the visible 25% and reconstructs pixels with a small decoder; this cuts pretraining time 3× or more, and an ImageNet-1K-only ViT-H reaches 87.8% fine-tuned; transfer beats supervised pretraining on COCO and ADE20K and prior bests on iNat/Places. |
| kirillov2023segment | 2023 | Segment Anything | segmentation, foundation-model, vision-transformer, promptable, dataset, zero-shot, state-representation | read | SAM: an MAE-pretrained ViT-H image encoder run once per image plus a light prompt encoder and mask decoder (~50 ms on CPU) that return 3 masks with predicted-IoU scores per prompt, trained on SA-1B (11M images, 1.1B automatic masks); zero-shot it beats RITM on 16 of 23 datasets from 1 point. |
| lee2022multigame | 2022 | Multi-Game Decision Transformers | reinforcement-learning, offline-rl, decision-transformer, multi-game, atari, scaling, transfer-learning, sequence-modeling | read | One decoder-only Decision Transformer (200M params) trained offline on mixed expert and non-expert DQN trajectories of 41 Atari games plays all of them at 126% human-normalized IQM (data: 101%), scales with model size, fine-tunes well to 5 held-out games, and beats BC, CQL and online C51. |
| liu2025prototypes | 2025 | Cross-domain Random Pre-training with Prototypes for Reinforcement Learning | reinforcement-learning, self-supervised, representation-learning, pretraining, cross-domain, prototypes, random-policy, dmcontrol | read | CRPTpro pre-trains one conv encoder on uniform-random-action frames from 3 DMControl domains with a SwAV-style next-frame prototype loss plus a prototype-spreading loss; frozen, it gets RAD-SAC to 1.956 mean expert-normalized score on 12 tasks (Proto-RL(C): 1.096) in 54% of its pre-training time. |
| ravi2024sam | 2024 | SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos | segmentation, video, foundation-model, promptable, memory, tracking, dataset, zero-shot, state-representation | read | Extends SAM to video: a streaming Hiera encoder plus a memory bank of past-frame features and object pointers lets a prompted object be segmented and tracked (a "masklet") across frames. Trained with a model-in-the-loop data engine (SA-V, 35.5M masks); beats SAM+tracker baselines. |
| reed2022generalist | 2022 | A Generalist Agent | generalist-agent, transformer, imitation-learning, multi-task, multi-embodiment, tokenization, atari, robotics, transfer, scaling | read | Gato: one 1.18B decoder-only transformer, one set of weights, trained by masked next-token prediction on tokenised text, images and expert-agent data from 596 control tasks; over 50% of expert on 450 of 604 tasks, but no transfer to held-out Atari Boxing and a context too short for in-context use. |
| saito2024relightable | 2024 | Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars | gaussian-splatting, avatars, neural-rendering, relighting, radiance-transfer, cvae, real-time-rendering | read | RGCA: a CVAE expression code (z ∈ R²⁵⁶) and gaze drive 2D-CNN decoders that output one 3D Gaussian per texel of a 1024² UV map, with learned radiance transfer (SH diffuse, spherical Gaussian specular), relit in real time; beats MVP/Linear/EyeNeRF combos on most metrics, ~31 ms/frame. |
| schulman2017proximal | 2017 | Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms | reinforcement-learning, policy-gradient, actor-critic, on-policy, trust-region, atari, continuous-control | read | PPO runs several epochs of minibatch SGD/Adam per batch of on-policy data on a clipped probability-ratio surrogate (ε = 0.2 best, 0.82 normalized score on 7 MuJoCo tasks); it beats TRPO, A2C and CEM on almost all of them, and on 49 Atari games wins 30 by learning speed (ACER 18). |
| serrano2024crossdomain | 2024 | Knowledge Transfer for Cross-Domain Reinforcement Learning: A Systematic Review | reinforcement-learning, transfer-learning, cross-domain, imitation-learning, survey | read | Survey of 53 methods that transfer knowledge between single-agent RL tasks whose state and/or action spaces differ, sorted by knowledge origin, source count and transfer form (Table II) and compared on data needs and similarity assumptions (Table III); lists open problems (Sec. VI). |
| simateam2024instructable | 2024 | Scaling Instructable Agents Across Many Simulated Worlds | embodied-agents, instruction-following, imitation-learning, multi-game, video-games, keyboard-mouse, language-grounding, transfer-learning | read | SIMA trains one language-conditioned agent by BC on human play in 3D research environments and games, screen pixels and text in, keyboard and mouse out; it beats per-environment specialists by 67% on average, sometimes matches them zero-shot, and gets 34% on No Man's Sky tasks (human experts 60%). |
| srinivas2020curl | 2020 | CURL: Contrastive Unsupervised Representations for Reinforcement Learning | reinforcement-learning, contrastive-learning, self-supervised, representation-learning, sample-efficiency, data-augmentation, atari, dm-control, state-representation | read | Adds a MoCo-style instance-discrimination loss (InfoNCE, bilinear similarity, momentum key encoder, random crops of frame stacks) to the pixel encoder of SAC or Efficient Rainbow, trained jointly. 1.9x Dreamer's median at DMControl100k, near state-based SAC at 500k, and 1.2x SimPLe on Atari100k. |
| vaswani2017attention | 2017 | Attention Is All You Need | transformer, attention, sequence-modeling, positional-encoding, machine-translation, architecture | read | The Transformer replaces recurrence and convolution with stacked multi-head self-attention and position-wise feed-forward layers plus sinusoidal positional encodings; the big model reaches 28.4 BLEU on WMT14 EN-DE (over 2 above prior ensembles) after 3.5 days on 8 P100 GPUs. |
| zhang2026balanced | 2026 | A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control | reinforcement-learning, curriculum-learning, task-sampling, exploration, massively-parallel-simulation, on-policy, robotics, sim-to-real | read | SGS samples each PPO episode's task configuration by a Beta-shaped score of its rolling success rate, peaking at moderate success; at 1M parallel envs it reaches 73% on 13-terrain quadruped locomotion (PLR 54%) and 70% on Franka nut-and-bolt (uniform 6%), and gains as envs grow where baselines stall. |
| zielonka2025drivable | 2025 | Drivable 3D Gaussian Avatars | gaussian-splatting, avatars, neural-rendering, cage-deformation, drivable, real-time-rendering | read | D3GA: full-body avatars as 3D Gaussians embedded in tetrahedral cages (body, face, garments), deformed by LBS plus small pose-conditioned MLPs, with each Gaussian's covariance warped by its tetrahedron's deformation gradient; best PSNR/SSIM vs. MVP/BD and MLP 3DGS avatars, ~26 FPS on a V100. |
